propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets and fragmented authorities, causing parser/help drift and inconsistent canonical help
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack safe canonical help and report as unknown to 'rebar help', while handler-owned '--help' is inconsistent and can execute work
Runtime parsing and documentation generation use separate authorities, allowing syntax/options to diverge from a single authoritative argparse factory definition
Help and unknown-command paths must resolve from pre-generated committed package bytes before operation/config/mount/handler initialization
All visible commands must appear once in grouped overview with exact aliases, compatibility spellings, hidden commands, and retired spellings exhibiting approved routing behavior
Lazy execution and semantic capability resolution must preserve mount/init, argv, confirmation, stream, exit-code, and legacy-output contracts while eliminating duplicate parser authorities
